title: AKARI Sounds BGM（v0）
description: The BGM pack from the in-house library AKARI Sounds. 99 tracks / 110 takes. Every track is AI-generated (Suno paid plan), and the generation record (time, prompt, and source URL) is public in akari-sounds catalog.json

author: AKARI Sounds
